purpose: Separate official corpus scale from locally obtained metadata and motion training data.
authorization_boundary: Public small metadata only; no whole video corpus, personal-data application, agreement submission, paid API or contact.

sources.language: American Sign Language with English translations
sources.unit: continuous signed sentence/video, not isolated vocabulary class
published_modalities: three-hour Panoptic subset enabling 3D pose estimation
public_download_listing_checked: original and manually realigned English sentence CSVs
sources.selected_local_modality: realigned English sentence text, IDs and timestamps only
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0; project page limits use to research and requires attribution; original How2 media has separate rights
limitations: Only metadata is being obtained; video/pose availability is not checked per instance
Homepage modality headings do not prove every modality is currently released
English token vocabulary is not an ASL gloss vocabulary
No robot joint trajectories are provided by the sentence CSV

published_modalities: gloss, split, signer/variation IDs, temporal bounds, bounding box metadata
sources.access_reason: Official README explicitly requires reading and agreeing to C-UDA before dataset use. No exception for metadata was established. Missing/preprocessed videos require a separate request form.
sources.license: Computational Use of Data Agreement (C-UDA); official page says academic/computational use only, no commercial use
limitations: Scale above is paper-reported, not a fresh local recount
Original video links can expire; no instance link has been tested here
Isolated glosses do not establish sentence generation or robot control targets

sources.unit: isolated sign and RGB video instance
sources.access_reason: Official Microsoft Research terms state use accepts an agreement; data use is non-commercial research and redistribution is restricted. The full ZIP is not small metadata.
limitations: Version 0.9 had a different video count; do not mix versions
Recognition/dictionary retrieval data is not already a text-to-robot motion corpus
No files or individual media availability were verified locally

sources.language: Includes ASL and PHOENIX-2014T German sign language subsets; repository labels the latter GSL; also HamNoSys and word subsets
sources.access_reason: Official annotations require a request form and agreement to the data license; original RGB is not redistributed and has separate source instructions.
limitations: The total is not an ASL-only corpus
Human SMPL-X/MANO parameters still require constrained robot retargeting
